name: fitlog
description: FitLog - 个人健身记录 PWA（训练 / 补剂 / 历史 / 统计）

scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend -- --host"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test:stats --workspace frontend
